[[File:Imperial_Engineer.jpg|thumb|right|An Imperial engineer wearing a protective suit]]
'''Protective suits''' were worn by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] while on duty. They consisted of a full body protection suit and a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], with [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and work [[Boot/Legends|boots]].
